text:
maria: Quick sync — Q3 spot strategy proposal: move from pure price-optimized to a dynamic windowed bidding model with a small capacity buffer per region. goal: reduce churn during short preemption spikes while keeping avg cost near current target.

alex: TL;dr?: how big is the buffer?

maria: thinking 8-12% warm buffer for critical pools (A100/T4 mix), 0-2% for burst-only pools. buffer should be free to preempt but we keep nodes warm to shorten cold-start.

jonathan: Windowed bidding = prefer lower bids for low-demand hours and higher bids on peak? any automation plan?

maria: yes. windows = time-of-day + market-signal. example config: 
```
# window example
{ "strategy": "windowed", "windows": [{"start":0,"end":3600,"max_bid_pct":70},{"start":3600,"end":7200,"max_bid_pct":95}], "warm_buffer_pct":10 }
```
We will wire this into procurement service to adjust max bid and preferred instance families.

devon: Concern: region failover. If eu-west2 tightens, do we spill to us-west1 or prefer same region with higher bid?

maria: policy: prefer same-region first (latency), but if preemption rate >20% sustained for 10m, trigger cross-region spill to designated secondary regions. keep cost cap.

kai: How do we measure success? metrics I want: preempt_rate, average_bid_pct, time_to_ready (coldstart), SLO_misses. add per-model cost/tokens for chargeback.

maria: agreed. We'll add a dashboard and alert: preempt_rate > 15% for 15m -> notify infra and throttle non-prod.

alex: rollout plan?

maria: phased: 1) sim on historical spot data (2 weeks), 2) small canary on dev pools (48h), 3) graduated to non-prod, 4) prod with rollback policy. automation will expose `max_bid_pct` and `warm_buffer_pct` flags per pool.

jonathan: what about mixed-capacity pools with different GPU types? e.g., A100 + A10 fallback.

maria: mixed pools treated with preference order and preempt thresholds. fallback allowed when latency impact < 25ms. // example rule: prefer A100, allow A10 if cost delta > 40% and perf degradation < 30%.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a canary run of windowed-bids on dev pools at 2026-04-15T03:00Z :rocket:

devon: ok, please add a limit on max-bid absolute cap (dollars/hour) so we never overspend during auctions.

maria: yep — max absolute cap per-region + per-pool. will draft PR with configs and simulation results this week. ping @alex for rollout docs. :thumbsup:

alex: sounds good. I'm happy to review the PR. small nit: include failure-mode tests for market blackouts.

maria: will do — adding blackout scenarios to sim (100% preempt for 30m).

kai: also log the instance type transitions in trace so we can attribute perf regressions to fallback.

maria: added to items. thanks all.
